statement: Capability and readiness forecast for every Gate from GATE15 to GATE40. This creates no contract, no authority and no START. It answers one question per Gate: would any currently-known missing infrastructure force this Gate to stop for a governance-mechanism reason that is already detectable today.
noSurpriseAnswer: NO. Every generic lifecycle primitive GATE15-GATE40 will need already exists, is validated, and has a GATE14 precedent. The only things absent for each Gate are the Gate-local artifacts that must not exist before it starts.

issueClassVocabulary.GATE_LOCAL_EXPECTED: Artifact is absent because the Gate has not started. Normal; not a gap.
issueClassVocabulary.PREEXECUTION_GAP: This Gate cannot start until something outside it is fixed.
issueClassVocabulary.SYSTEMIC_GAP: The generic lifecycle itself is broken.

regressionBaselineAvailable.precedent: 70 failure identities recorded at baseline HEAD
